title: Sharing your work
summary: Push a branch to origin, then pull a teammate's commit.

say.never: Your project folder is the **local** copy. Teams also keep a shared copy on a server, like **GitHub**, called the **remote**. The remote is usually named **origin**. You work locally, then **push** to send your commits up, and **pull** to bring teammates' commits down. In this lesson `origin` is a private copy on this computer, so no account is needed.
say.bit: Local = your copy. Remote (`origin`) = the shared copy on GitHub. Push uploads, pull downloads. Here `origin` is a hidden local copy.

say.never: Click the **Source Control** icon on the left: the one that looks like a branch.

Look at the very bottom of the window. The name just left of the branch is the repository you're working on. Click it and choose **06-push** from the list at the top. Source Control now shows only that repository.
say.bit: Bottom-left, click the repository name and choose **06-push**.

say.never: The branch name beside it now belongs to that repository. It should say `issue-18-team-colors`. If it says something else, click it and pick `issue-18-team-colors`.
say.bit: The branch beside it should say `issue-18-team-colors`. If not, click it and pick `issue-18-team-colors`.

say.never: Point at the **CHANGES** heading in Source Control. A **...** button (More Actions) appears at its right end. Click it. It works on the repository you picked.
Point at **Pull, Push** in the menu. A second menu opens beside it. Click **Push to...** there. If a pop-up asks whether to "periodically run git fetch", click **No**.
say.bit: **Pull, Push**, then **Push to...**. Say **No** to any git fetch pop-up.

say.never: Click `origin` in the list at the top. That sends your branch to the shared copy.
Now click the repository name in the bottom-left corner again and choose **07-pull**. The branch name beside it should say `develop`. Source Control now shows only that repository.
say.bit: Bottom-left: choose **07-pull**. It should be on `develop`.

say.never: Point at the **CHANGES** heading in Source Control. A **...** button (More Actions) appears at its right end. Click it. It works on the repository you picked.
Point at **Pull, Push**, then click **Pull** in the second menu. Open `Schedule.txt`: your teammate's line is there.
say.bit: **Pull, Push**, then **Pull**. Your teammate's line is in `Schedule.txt`.

say.never: Open the lesson chip and press **Verify** for **Push** and **Pull**.
